answer: Unique-Human Kernel Witnessing.** Each agent identity must resolve a fresh challenge that only a live human at an oasis terminal can answer, and the result is checked against a rotating kernel of prior witnesses who must cosign without overlap. An attacker minting N identities pays N terminal sessions plus N disjoint witness sets, so cost scales linearly with identity count while honest agents amortize one session. Coordination above the zenith of ten linked witnesses is refused outright.
